description: This file defines API endpoint functions for various services such as authentication, health checks, data assets, submissions, validation, audit, and evidence. It includes documentation comments, imports external utility functions, and exports multiple API interface objects with methods for making HTTP requests to backend endpoints.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user via POST /api/v1/auth/register.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Logs in a user via POST /api/v1/auth/login.

methods.name: me
methods.description: Fetches current user profile via GET /api/v1/auth/me.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Performs a liveness probe via GET /health.

methods.name: ready
methods.description: Performs a readiness probe via GET /ready.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a data asset with metadata via POST /api/v1/data-assets.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a data asset by ID via GET /api/v1/data-assets/{id}.

methods.name: triggerValidation
methods.description: Triggers validation run for a data asset via POST /api/v1/data-assets/{id}/validate.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Approves or rejects a data asset via POST /api/v1/data-assets/{id}/approve.

methods.name: createCompat
methods.description: Creates a submission via deprecated legacy endpoint POST /submissions.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a submission by ID via GET /api/v1/submissions/{id}.

methods.name: triggerValidation
methods.description: Triggers validation for a submission via POST /api/v1/submissions/{id}/validate.

methods.name: runQualityGatesCompat
methods.description: Runs quality gates on a submission via POST /submissions/{id}/quality-gates/run.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Approves or rejects a submission via POST /api/v1/submissions/{id}/approve.

methods.name: approveCompat
methods.description: Simplified approval for submission via deprecated endpoint.

methods.name: publishCompat
methods.description: Publishes a submission via deprecated endpoint.

methods.name: queryEvents
methods.description: Queries audit events via GET /api/v1/audit/events with optional filters.

methods.name: getEvidencePackage
methods.description: Retrieves evidence package by ID via GET /api/v1/evidence-packages/{id}.
